units.source_text: “从祇园走到岛原的角屋去看高级艺伎吧。

en.t: Let's walk from Gion to Sumiya in Shimabara and go see the high-class geisha.

units.source_text: 高级艺伎的衣裳，才是货真价实的呢。

en.t: The costumes of high-class geisha are the real thing.

units.source_text: 侍女们也……在粗大的蜡烛照明下，喏，举行叫什么敬酒的仪式。

en.t: The attendants, too... under the light of thick candles, you see, perform some ceremony called a toast or libation.

units.source_text: 最后在门口的土间，还让我们看了看高级艺伎盛装游行时的装束。”

en.t: Finally, in the earthen-floored entrance, they also showed us the outfits worn when the high-class geisha parade in full dress.
